Class Frame

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.terminal.Frame
public final class Frame extends Object
A frame represents a single render cycle. Widgets are rendered to the frame's buffer.

    • renderWidget

      public void renderWidget(Widget widget, Rect area)
      Renders a widget to the given area.

      If the widget implements RawOutputCapable, the raw output stream will be passed to enable native terminal protocol rendering.

      Parameters:
      widget - the widget to render
      area - the area to render within

    • setStyledAreaRegistry

      public void setStyledAreaRegistry(StyledAreaRegistry registry)
      Sets the styled area registry for tracking styled content.

      When set, styled content written to the buffer with Tags will be automatically registered in the registry for effect targeting.

      Parameters:
      registry - the registry, or null to disable tracking

    • pushContextKey

      public void pushContextKey(String contextKey)
      Pushes a context key onto the stack.

      The context key is used to associate styled areas with a parent context. Typically, this is called when entering an element's render scope with the element's ID as the context key.

      Parameters:
      contextKey - the context key (typically an element ID)

    • popContextKey

      public void popContextKey()
      Pops the most recent context key from the stack.

      This should be called when exiting an element's render scope.

    • currentContextKey

      public String currentContextKey()
      Returns the current context key (top of the stack).

      This is used to associate styled areas with their containing element.

      Returns:
      the current context key, or null if no context is active
